name: web_search
description: Search the web through Kagi and return ranked results as structured data: title, url, snippet, and time for each hit. Requires KAGI_API_KEY in the executor's environment; when it is not configured the tool reports itself unavailable, so fall back to fetch_url against URLs you already know. Pair it with fetch_url: search to find the pages, then fetch the ones that matter.

detailed: Searches the web via Kagi and returns ranked results.
whimsical: Send the bloodhound across the web.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is searching the web via Kagi

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5; values above 10 are clamped to 10.
